desc: Derive a correct DP state/transition formulation enforcing that every final run has length at least 3.
Optimize differing-letter transitions to \(O(26n)\) and determine memory requirements for \(n \le 5\cdot10^4\).
Define suffix-based lexicographic reconstruction that selects the smallest globally optimal output.
Validate against examples and edge cases, including lengths below 3 and alternating characters.
